# Update Fixes Checklist: Payment + Outfit Post-Test Bugs

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for the update covering 5 post-test bug reports (payment success destination, outfit list navbar, open-in-studio tab, AI form options, AI-create auto-scroll)
**Created**: 2026-09-13
**Feature**: specs/003-fix-wallet-topup/spec.md and specs/002-user-outfits-tab/spec.md

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are post-payment-success destination requirements specified for every return path (in-app polling success, deep-link return, web returnUrl, cold-start reopen)? [Completeness, 003 Spec §FR-005, §US3/AS1]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the content requirements of the top-up success notification specified (shown amount, order code, updated balance, CTA destination)? [Completeness, 003 Spec §US2/AS2]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are destination requirements specified for the post-create-outfit navigation (shell tab with navbar vs pushed page without navbar)? [Completeness, 002 Spec §FR-001, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are target-tab requirements specified for the "open in studio" action (Studio canvas tab vs AI-suggest tab)? [Completeness, Gap, 002 Spec §US2/AS2]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are the reduced option sets for occasion, style, and favorite color specified (exact 3 options each)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are auto-scroll-after-AI-create requirements specified (trigger moment, target item identity, fallback when refresh fails)? [Completeness, Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is the success destination distinguished from forbidden destinations (e.g., is redirect-to-home explicitly excluded)? [Clarity, 003 Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the "3 options" rule quantified — exactly 3 fixed options, maximum 3, or 3 defaults with custom additions allowed? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Gap] → **Reviewer decision 2026-09-13: 3 options cố định cứng + 1 ô text tự nhập phía dưới cho giá trị khác.**
- [x] CHK009 - Is "auto scroll so the user sees the new outfit" quantified (timing after success response, animated vs instant, final scroll position)? [Clarity, Gap] → **Reviewer decision 2026-09-13: scroll ngay sau response success, animated.**
- [ ] CHK010 - Is "open in studio" defined with a measurable end state (which tab is visible, outfit loaded on canvas)? [Clarity, 002 Spec §US2/AS2]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Are post-success destination requirements consistent between the top-up flow and the direct-purchase flow (wallet vs membership page)? [Consistency, 003 Spec §US3/AS1 vs §US3/AS2]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are navbar-preservation requirements consistent across all entries to the outfit list (tab tap, post-create navigation, back from detail)? [Consistency, 002 Spec §FR-001, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are "open in studio" requirements consistent regardless of the origin tab (AI-suggest tab vs Studio tab)? [Consistency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are the 3-option AI form requirements consistent with backend acceptance (does the API accept or reject values outside the 3)? [Consistency, Gap, Assumption]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 - Can "lands on the success notification instead of home" be objectively verified as a measurable assertion? [Measurability, 003 Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are acceptance criteria specified for the reduced option lists (exact labels, display order, single vs multi select)? [Acceptance Criteria, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 - Can "the user sees the newly created outfit without manual scrolling" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Gap]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 - Are destination requirements defined for payment cancellation and failure paths, not only for success? [Coverage, 003 Spec §US2/AS4]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are requirements defined for outfit creation failure (stay on form with error vs navigate to list)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for AI-create edge cases (empty result, request timeout, list refresh fails before scroll)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for cold-start returns (app killed during external payment, then reopened via deep link)? [Coverage, 003 Spec Edge Cases]
